hard_requirements: CONTRAST: Zero light grey subtext. All text must strictly pass WCAG 2.1 AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text). On dark backgrounds, secondary text must be #E2E8F0 (slate-200) or #F1F5F9 (slate-100). On light surfaces, text must be #0F172A (slate-900).

FONT FAMILY: Pure sans-serif typography strictly enforced across the entire site ('Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Public Sans', or 'Outfit' with 'Inter' fallback). Serif fonts banned to maintain crisp rendering for low-vision readers.
MINIMUM TEXT SIZES: Smallest body/caption text must be >= 16px (1rem / 12pt). Heading & subhead text strictly >= 18px (1.125rem). Small labels are forbidden from dropping below 14px bold.
LINE HEIGHT & SPACING: Minimum 1.5x font size for all body paragraphs (leading-relaxed / leading-6). Paragraph bottom margin must be at least 2x font size (mb-6 / space-y-6).
REFLOW & ZOOM: Layout must sustain 200% browser zoom without horizontal scrolling, text clipping, overlap, or broken component containers.
FOCUS & KEYBOARD: Focus rings must be visible 3px outline in high-contrast electric blue (#3A86FF) with 2px offset. Interactive targets minimum 44x44px target area.
DECORATIVE ANIMATION: Respects 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Decorative canvases and motion elements fall back gracefully to static high-contrast visual states.

chapters.title: Invisible Documents

chapters.desc: Manual tagging costs $15–$45 per page and takes weeks. Public agencies face backlogs of 50,000+ un-remediated PDFs.

items.q: What exact standards does ADA Corrector check against?
items.a: ADA Corrector evaluates and fixes documents against WCAG 2.1 Level AA, Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, and PDF/UA (ISO 14289-1) international standards.

items.q: How does your 'honest reporting' guarantee work?
items.a: Unlike legacy software that rubber-stamps documents, ADA Corrector runs a secondary verification engine. If a complex architectural blueprint or handwritten signature cannot be 100% programmatically validated, it alerts you with exact page coordinates rather than giving a false pass.

items.q: Can ADA Corrector handle scanned image-only PDFs?
items.a: Yes. Built-in OCR extracts text layers before analyzing logical DOM reading order, heading levels, and semantic tags.

items.q: Do you offer enterprise procurement / VPAT documentation?
items.a: Yes. EnhanceGov provides complete VPAT 2.4 documentation, SOC 2 Type II reports, and custom invoicing for government purchase orders.

items.q: Is my confidential agency data secure?
items.a: All files are processed in zero-knowledge encrypted memory enclaves and automatically deleted 24 hours after remediation unless saved to your vault.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow all WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines specified in accessibility_mandate_wcag_2_1_aa.
Ensure ALL text on dark navy backgrounds uses white (#FFFFFF) or high contrast light slate (#E2E8F0) — zero dark gray or low-contrast light grey subtext allowed.
Use sans-serif font family ('Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Public Sans', 'Inter') throughout the site.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, links, accordion headers, form inputs, and interactive tabs (e.g., data-testid='hero-scan-cta-button').
Do NOT add a Testimonials section (user explicitly requested to leave out testimonials entirely).
Implement the 9 specified page sections in exact sequence.
Ensure line-height is at least 1.5 (leading-relaxed) and paragraph bottom margins are at least 2 font sizes (mb-6).
Verify layout usability at 200% zoom with zero text collisions or unexpected overflow.
